name: euler2d_wedge
title: Oblique shock on a 10 deg wedge at Mach 2 (2D Euler, external_2d)

reference.quantity: Shock angle beta (fitted through the shock position at 6 stations)
reference.source: theta-beta-M relation, weak shock, M1 = 2, theta = 10 deg, gamma = 1.4 (Anderson 2003, sec. 4.4)

reference.quantity: Wedge surface pressure / free-stream pressure p2/p1
reference.source: Oblique-shock relation p2/p1 = 1 + 2 gamma/(gamma + 1)(M1² sin² beta - 1) with beta = 39.314 deg (Anderson 2003, eq. 4.9)

reference.quantity: Mach number behind the shock (on the wedge surface cells)
reference.source: Oblique-shock relation M2 = Mn2 / sin(beta - theta) (Anderson 2003, eq. 4.12)

study.title: Two meshes
notes: Cd includes the base drag of the flat base (the base pressure is not part of the oblique-shock theory).
